issue.title: Support Antigravity explicit effort with per-model levels and CLI compatibility
issue.description: Proposing bead: sase-1ss.1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1. On sase cf7a09f15b, AgyProvider.invocation_option_args passes supported={} to effort_cli_args, rejecting explicit effort. Independently verified agy 1.5.8 --help advertises low|medium|high|xhigh|max. Accepted research records base-slug plus effort success and conflicting slug/effort rejection. Design per-model capability maps (Argon has no xhigh), compatible base-slug catalog entries, a minimum-CLI/version gate, and slug-versus-explicit-effort conflict behavior. Keep existing suffixed selectors working. Shared capability/validation behavior belongs in sase-core; keep Python glue thin. Review decisions:size-alias-effort-ladder and use the memory workflow for any superseding decision. Correct obsolete adapter wording that upstream exposes no effort. Cover invocation argv, unsupported levels, old CLI behavior, aliases and docs. Large because model policy, compatibility, and decision boundaries need planning.

task_type_fields.proposal: Add explicit agy effort routing with per-model validation, stable base slugs, CLI-version compatibility, and tests.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1ss expressly supports fixed-effort Hydrogen slug variants and defers adapter effort passthrough and ladder policy.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1ss.1 note #1; agy 1.5.8 now advertises --effort, while SASE intentionally rejects it. This requires a distinct adapter and model-policy design beyond Hydrogen slug cataloguing.

payload.description: Effort base-slug support and catalog reconciliation touch the same agy manifest; preserve compatibility.
Adjacent AgyProvider changes: effort passthrough and instruction delivery should avoid conflicting adapter edits.
Future ladder choices must use fixed-effort slugs until explicit agy effort support is implemented.
